newsitem.title: USA: UAL's Shuttle expands Arizona service.
newsitem.headline: UAL's Shuttle expands Arizona service.

text.p: UAL Corp said its Shuttle by United domestic, short-haul airline will expand in Arizona with new routes to Tucson and expanded service to Phoenix.

Beginning February 11, 1997, the Shuttle will launch three day round-trip flights between Tucson and Los Angeles and will add 13 daily round-trip flights between Phoenix and Denver. Tickets will open for sale beginning November 16.
Currently, United Airlines operates nine round-trip flights via its regular service between Phoenix and Denver, and does not serive the non-stop Tucson-Los Angeles market.
With this new expansion, the Shuttle will grow to 452 daily departures to 20 cities throughout the western United States.
